review_type: targeted desk review, not systematic review or independent specialist sign-off

records.title: Capturing shell-crushing by large mobile predators using passive acoustics technology
records.access: Search-accessible abstract summary; publisher returned HTTP 403. Full methods and raw data not reviewed.
records.population: Whitespotted eagle rays Aetobatus narinari consuming molluscs; not Sparus aurata
records.finding: Shell fractures produce brief acoustic signals, with reported peaks around 3.1-5.0 kHz. This supports studying passive feeding sounds, not selecting an orada detector band.
records.limitations: Different predator/prey/setup. No local labeled orada recordings or performance. Do not transfer reported range, level or band to Lim Bay.
records.decision: Collect permitted independent local audio/video evidence before detector, receive-band or localization design freeze.
records.remaining_gate: Local observed feeding and hard negatives, split by recording/day/site, with timing uncertainty and visibility.

records.title: ARIEL D.T2.4.1 Croatian regional pilot report, seabream pinger pilot
records.access: Official DOCX downloaded and relevant pilot/results/conclusion text directly inspected. Archive 9902060 bytes, SHA256 275ef4f8e291b2f6f9b7e8b15f10982d689d288446315ae7ed677edc5ab15b8c. Downloaded binary not committed.
records.location: Seabream pilot: Pilot area; Pilot testing results; Second experiment conducted in July; Conclusion
records.population: 2019 Lim Bay mussel farms, two concessions, six DDD03L devices, reported seabream predation
records.finding: May deployment initially showed little predation, but severe predation followed by mid-July. The July repeat also lost protection after about two weeks. Report concludes tested devices were non-functional against fish predation.
records.limitations: Project-level observed outcome, not a fully specified randomized sham-controlled study. Temperature, seasonal predation, stock condition, device operation and habituation remain confounded; causal attribution to habituation alone is not established. Historical device range/output specifications are not verified Poseidon parameters.
records.decision: Do not repeat DDD03L or its 5-500 kHz/roughly 140 kHz peak as a validated baseline. Negative result neither proves all acoustic approaches impossible nor approves another frequency/level.
records.remaining_gate: Obtain raw observations, controls, operating/calibration logs and specialist review only after owner authorizes contact. No request sent.

records.title: PREDADOR project results
records.access: Public project page directly fetched; 2011 is project labelling date, not verified trial year.
records.population: Gilthead seabream at Brest/Quiberon shellfish concessions
records.finding: Page claims response of large seabream schools and estimated 200-300 m range, but also reports habituation on mussel longlines and further reliability/environmental assessment needs.
records.limitations: No sample sizes, randomized controls, duration, calibrated exposure, effect-size uncertainty or stock-loss dataset on page. Range and effectiveness are project claims, not a measured Poseidon specification.
records.decision: Preserve conflicting initial-effect and habituation claims. Request methods before using this as efficacy evidence, subject to separate contact approval.
records.remaining_gate: Controlled sustained feeding/stock-loss outcomes and non-target assessment, not startle or short-term absence alone.

records.title: The mechanism for directional hearing in fish
records.access: Open full text via Europe PMC XML; Nature website redirected to an identity cookie endpoint.
records.location: Directional startle responses; The directional hearing algorithm; The hearing apparatus; Discussion
records.finding: Experiments separate pressure and particle-motion pathways and manipulate their phase relationship; reversing the pressure/motion relationship reverses directional escape. Demonstrated anatomy includes Weberian pressure coupling.
records.limitations: Small laboratory fish with species-specific hearing anatomy; brief controlled startle stimuli, not seabream audiometry, field propagation or sustained deterrence. Directional hearing in a fish is not hydrophone-array localization validation.
records.decision: Keep pressure and particle-motion exposure measurements distinct; do not infer a seabream threshold or treatment from this mechanism.
records.remaining_gate: Species-specific hearing/exposure review and measured local acoustic field with uncertainty.

records.title: The effect of low frequency noise on the behaviour of juvenile Sparus aurata
records.access: HR Wallingford repository abstract fetched; full text not present there. Palermo/publisher access blocked. Details beyond abstract remain unverified.
records.population: Juvenile Sparus aurata under laboratory exposure
records.finding: Seven-hour exposure in bands centered at 63, 125, 500 and 1000 Hz compared with control measured group dispersion, movement and swimming height. Responses and habituation depended on frequency.
records.limitations: Behavioral response is not an audiogram or safe exposure threshold. Laboratory juvenile response is not durable predation prevention in Lim Bay. No waveform or acoustic level is recommended from these results.
records.decision: Include species-specific response and habituation evidence but leave output disabled.
records.remaining_gate: Full method, pressure/motion characterization, independent safety/ethics review and preregistered efficacy design.

records.title: Marine and Freshwater Sounds Impact Invertebrate Behavior and Physiology: A Meta-Analysis
records.access: Open full text via Europe PMC XML; ordinary PMC page served recaptcha.
records.location: Methods literature screening/data extraction; Results; Discussion limitations
records.population: 46 studies, 50 aquatic invertebrate species and 835 extracted data points, mostly marine
records.finding: Synthesis reports adverse physiological associations for anthropogenic/synthetic sounds, including molluscs and arthropods, but several behavioral/outcome aggregates include zero and environmental sound results vary.
records.limitations: Not new primary measurements. Exposure/species/life-stage heterogeneity, possible publication bias, tank sound fields, uneven particle-motion measurement and uncertain benefit/harm interpretation prevent a universal or site-specific threshold. Limited music evidence does not support flora claims.
records.decision: Non-target assessment must include cultured shellfish and other invertebrates, not only the target fish. Keep null and conflicting findings visible.
records.remaining_gate: Site species/habitat inventory and independently reviewed pressure/particle-motion assessment and abort rules.

records.title: Seagrass Posidonia is impaired by human-generated noise
records.access: Open full text via Europe PMC XML, including methods and limitations; Nature website redirected.
records.location: Materials and methods: Plant material, Sound exposure protocol, Sample collection; Results SEM/TEM and starch-grain analysis; Discussion
records.population: Posidonia oceanica roots/rhizomes and root fungal symbionts in laboratory tanks
records.finding: Two-hour laboratory sweep exposure (50-400 Hz) compared with no-playback controls was followed by reduced starch-grain counts and ultrastructural changes over 24-120 hours. This is adverse cellular evidence, not stimulation benefit.
records.limitations: Artificial tank exposure; pressure and particle-motion contributions not isolated. Limited samples and descriptive TEM; not a frequency/level dose-response threshold study. Growth, survival, meadow effects and long-term recovery not established. Exposure units are not adopted as a design specification.
records.decision: Flora stimulation remains independent research-only. Evidence of possible harm contradicts an assumed generic growth benefit; monitoring work does not depend on this track.
records.remaining_gate: Species/endpoint-specific independently reviewed evidence, ecological authorization and replicated controlled benefit/harm assessment before any experiment.

records.title: Unverified Poseidon hypotheses
records.access: No supporting local dataset or approved experiment in this workstream.
records.population: Proposed Lim Bay orada monitoring/intervention and unspecified flora
records.finding: Local acoustic species identification, useful crack-detection range, dolphin imitation efficacy, a safe frequency/level, and beneficial flora stimulation are not established.
records.limitations: Synthetic unit tests establish software arithmetic and fault handling only. Digital peak/RMS is not underwater SPL; visual presence is not feeding and feeding is not quantified stock loss.
records.decision: No biological, calibration, permission, hardware qualification or production claim.
records.remaining_gate: Real independent measured evidence and human specialist/authority decisions; no inferred permission from software.
